scope: Step A: engine tests, device proof, connected CPU probe and queue (arms, grade, arm loop); hub and exact pinned-container CPU tests; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: step-a-connected-network
leaves.replaces: CUDA devices, streams, event buses, the model forward and the MQ transport around NativeSegmentDriver, NativeWorkerBridge, LaneDispatcher, QsaLayerDriver and QsaPrefillOperation
leaves.equivalence: ProfileNetwork's declared CPU leaves; events resolve only when the test completes them, so a host wait or a wrong order shows as a stuck or refused command
leaves.cannot_prove: device order, bytes, NCCL behaviour, real timing

leaves.name: step-a-auto-arm-state
leaves.replaces: AutoArmPolicy.manual_owned/phase/active and the armed admission intent
leaves.equivalence: the real _progress_owned predicate reads these fields; the real policy and latch are in test_e3_native_qsa_fused.Control and test_native41_autoarm
leaves.cannot_prove: the auto-arm cycle itself

leaves.name: step-a-no-qsa-driver
leaves.replaces: QsaLayerDriver on stage 1 of the connected model
leaves.equivalence: r4.FakeDriver plus an empty schedule list: this fixture's stage 1 owns no QSA layer; both stages' real drivers run on the box
leaves.cannot_prove: a stage 1 QSA layer in the connected test

leaves.name: step-a-tp-pynccl
leaves.replaces: PyNcclCommunicator: unique_id, world_size, disabled, all_reduce and broadcast
leaves.equivalence: The leaf carries a ncclUniqueId-shaped ctypes structure and world_size, the fields the real ledger reads. test_ledger_reads_what_real_pynccl_has reads the reference source for both, and a missing attribute raises instead of hashing None.
leaves.cannot_prove: a real NCCL collective, its order on the device, or its liveness

leaves.name: step-a-tp-torch
leaves.replaces: torch.cuda.current_stream read by the communicator
leaves.equivalence: returns the lane stream token the leaf PyNccl ignores
leaves.cannot_prove: stream scope

leaves.name: step-a-post-seam
leaves.replaces: RowParallelLinear.o_proj entering the TP group from _flash_e3_attention_post
leaves.equivalence: wraps only a synthetic attention instance to enter the real communicator at the production seam
leaves.cannot_prove: the generated post path

leaves.name: step-a-pending-peer
leaves.replaces: a peer that has not yet accepted the broadcast
leaves.equivalence: typed pending in front of the real peer bridge, as test_e3_native_tp_tail_skew; the fused path itself never returns pending
leaves.cannot_prove: MQ delivery order

leaves.name: step-a-mutants
leaves.replaces: _fused_agree, _fused_watchdog, _fused_hold, _progress_owned, _send_plan_entry, advance_fused
leaves.equivalence: named negative controls: each patched for one scenario, which must fail; no pass depends on them
leaves.cannot_prove: anything beyond discrimination

leaves.name: step-a-device-admitted
leaves.replaces: LaneChunk's admission and metadata fields
leaves.equivalence: the same fields written directly because make_alignment's lane tables hold 32 pages and the proof needs 73; the operation, plan and sources are real
leaves.cannot_prove: LaneTables above 32 pages in this probe (the B5 scenario runs the real one)

leaves.name: step-a-device-delays
leaves.replaces: a decode step ahead on the stream, a busy DMA engine
leaves.equivalence: real GPU matmuls and real DMA queued ahead of the first kernel or copy, checked live with their own event
leaves.cannot_prove: the box's contention pattern

leaves.name: step-a-device-mutant
leaves.replaces: NativeQsaDevice.wait_event
leaves.equivalence: named negative controls that skip one wait type; the bytes must differ; no pass depends on them
leaves.cannot_prove: anything beyond discrimination

leaves.name: LeafUniqueId
leaves.replaces: pynccl_wrapper.ncclUniqueId
leaves.equivalence: Same ctypes layout (internal: c_byte * 128); the test compares it with the reference source. PyNccl broadcasts the id at init, so peers hold equal bytes, which the leaf models with one tag.
leaves.cannot_prove: That the box lane communicators hold equal ids: the first box fused chunk shows it, a difference fails closed as tp-ledger-mismatch.
leaves.more_convenient: No NCCL library on the hub.
leaves.box_evidence: ledger_checks in the fused arms with 0 tp-ledger-mismatch.

leaves.name: Burst progress meta and direct submit
leaves.replaces: NativeProgress.with_meta wire key and the owned transport direct flag
leaves.equivalence: The worker seam pops the key before dispatch (executor_hooks) and direct changes only the reply path, which test_e3_native_reply_hol proves. The permit, drain and drive are the real ones.
leaves.cannot_prove: Burst pacing against a real decode loop.
leaves.more_convenient: The fixture has no worker seam or reply thread.
leaves.box_evidence: Fused live arms: progress lines, commands per chunk, capped waits.

leaves.name: s5_startup._enabled
leaves.replaces: The overlap composition settings the guards come after
leaves.equivalence: The refusals under test are the real guards in install_engine; only the unrelated composition precondition is answered.
leaves.cannot_prove: Full engine install with fused on: the engine self-run covers it.
leaves.more_convenient: The composition needs many settings unrelated to the refusals.
leaves.box_evidence: The queue engine starts with the fused settings.

leaves.name: connected-layer-driver
leaves.replaces: QsaLayerDriver and QsaPrefillOperation under a fused grant, through the dispatcher driver_factory
leaves.equivalence: The dispatcher's fused path calls exactly fused_profiles and arm_fused on its driver. LeafQsaDriver answers fused_profiles with engine_driver.fused_expected_shape, the shape test_e3_native_qsa_fused proves the real QsaPrefillOperation.fused_shape returns, and asserts the grant's layer and fused bit in arm_fused as QsaLayerDriver.arm_fused does.
leaves.cannot_prove: The real QSA layer under a real Core step: its events, buckets, tail and device work. Those run in test_e3_native_qsa_fused (FusedNetwork) and the V3 device probe; the box is the first place the whole stack is live.

leaves.name: connected-tp-leaf
leaves.replaces: PyNccl under the prefill TP communicator, the torch stream call, and the layer forward that issues the all-reduce
leaves.equivalence: The real PrefillTpCommunicator and CollectiveLedger run over LeafPynccl. FakeLane.layer enters comm.all_reduce once per layer with one fixed message shape on every peer, so the real driver's ledger agreement sees equal, real digests.
leaves.cannot_prove: NCCL behaviour, real message order and shape in the layer; a peer that truly diverges is test_e3_native_qsa_fused.Commitment.

leaves.name: connected-stepped-layer
leaves.replaces: The stepped QSA protocol (profile polls, pause, tail-ready, tail) on this leaf path
leaves.equivalence: The parent probe's FakeLane has no dense schedule, so a stepped layer on this path is a plain layer: the stepped modes prove that installing the switch and selecting stepped changes nothing byte for byte against the frozen progress-burst* records, not that the stepped protocol runs.
leaves.cannot_prove: The stepped dense protocol itself, which test_native43_dense_boundary and test_e3_native_qsa_fused drive.

leaves.name: arm-control-replies
leaves.replaces: The serving router and engine replies to the arm's control sequence, for the refusal and ordering cases
leaves.equivalence: The reply rows are the shapes the real router, session and driver produce, and the positive shapes are compared with them in Router and Arm over the real control plane.
leaves.cannot_prove: A reply shape the real engine stops producing: Router and Arm hold that.

leaves.name: arm-http-no-scheduler
leaves.replaces: The link from the HTTP prompt to the scheduler (inherited from held-f's Arm)
leaves.equivalence: The exact arm CLI drives real NativeRuntimeClients over loopback HTTP into the real endpoint, session, control client, driver, AutoArmPolicy, NativeProgress and FusedQsa of a startup-bound stack. No native chunk runs; a fused chunk on a connected Core is e3_step_a_probe.
leaves.cannot_prove: A real chunk under the arm command line; only the box has that.

leaves.name: grade-synthetic-run
leaves.replaces: Twelve arms' engine streams, client logs, watch records and ingress receipts
leaves.equivalence: Progress lines are written by the real nm.ProgressTrace emitters (StepEmit), row kinds and profile rows as the held-f run's engine stream had them (12 profile rows per chunk on the stepped path); memory receipts in the engine's flash-s5 memory format. Grade code is real.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real values; that the box's stream has the profile rows the stepped rule counts (it has on the parent, run 2 of held-f, and the rule is stated in the report).

leaves.name: arm-loop-clients
leaves.replaces: The arm client and the FULL-entry and health clients inside the derived arm loop
leaves.equivalence: Stubs print or exit as the real clients do; the bash body, draft functions, death watch and grade are real.
leaves.cannot_prove: The clients themselves, which Arm and alpha-perf's suites hold.

leaves.name: test-scale-workloads
leaves.replaces: Band 1 and band 2 prompts at their real length
leaves.equivalence: Same manifest schema and refusal checks with test-scale token ids; the real manifests are alpha-perf's, by name, in the frozen bundle.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real tokenization and chunk counts on the box.
